name: FFS_LOGIN_HISTORY
description: List of login events with additional info.

columns.name: SESSIONID
columns.description: Session ID generated by Login Portal.

columns.name: LOGIN_TIME
columns.description: Time in UTC when login event was registered.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: ID of the user. FK for the SECURITY_USER table.

columns.name: ULOGIN
columns.description: Login name used by user for login.

columns.name: APP_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the application where login was performed. Possible values: android_app/ios_app/browser.

columns.name: APP_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the used Mobile App.

columns.name: BROWSER
columns.description: A version of the browser that was used by the user in this sign-in.

columns.name: BROWSER_VERSION
columns.description: A version of the browser which was used by user in this sign in.

columns.name: DEVICE_MODEL
columns.description: Model of the device which was used for login.

columns.name: DEVICE_OS
columns.description: OS and OS version of the device which was used for login.

columns.name: IP
columns.description: Client IP where request for login comes from.

columns.name: TOTAL_MEM
columns.description: Total memory on the device that was used by the user in this sign-in.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_MEM
columns.description: Amount of the available memory on the device when login occures.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
